selection_approach_display: Bristol checks academic eligibility and ranks eligible applicants by UCAT within separate Home and International applicant pools. Contextual eligibility may provide a reduced academic offer but does not itself guarantee an interview. A separate guaranteed-interview route may apply to applicants on specific verified Bristol widening-participation programmes.

course.name: MB ChB Medicine
course.notes: Five-year standard-entry Medicine. Graduates apply through this A100 route; Bristol does not offer a separate graduate-entry Medicine programme in the supplied research.

medical_school.name: Bristol Medical School
medical_school.notes: Production rules are mapped from the approved Bristol A100 research document supplied by the user.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Eligible Home applicants, including Scottish and Rest of UK applicants, are ranked in the Home UCAT pool.
Eligible overseas fee-paying applicants are ranked separately against International UCAT guidance.

Verified completers of recognised University of Bristol widening participation programmes may receive a guaranteed interview when the published eligibility criteria are met. The verified group is assigned only after structured programme-completion evidence has been checked.

overall_policy.description: Bristol checks minimum academic requirements first. Applicants who meet the minimum academic requirements are ranked for interview by UCAT cognitive total only, except verified Bristol widening participation programme completers who may receive a guaranteed interview.
not_eligible_if: The applicable academic minimum requirements are not met.
A current-cycle UCAT cognitive total is not supplied.
A required science A-level practical endorsement is not passed.
An International applicant does not satisfy Bristol Profile A English language requirements or an accepted exemption.

science_requirement.notes: Bristol relies on A-level Chemistry plus a second science or maths subject; no GCSE science requirement is specified in the approved research.

accepted_equivalencies: Double Science accepted as an equivalent where relevant, although GCSE Science is not a formal Bristol A100 requirement
gcse.sitting_policy: GCSE resits are accepted to meet the minimum academic entry requirements.
gcse.notes: GCSEs are not scored. Only English Language and Mathematics are checked for the supported GCSE route.

a_level.notes: Predicted or achieved A-level grades are not scored once the minimum academic threshold is met. Bristol does not require three A-levels to be taken in one sitting.

ib.notes: IB standard and contextual routes are both implemented for supported applicant groups.

scottish.notes: Scottish applicants are assessed in the Home pool, but automatic Scottish eligibility remains a manual-review boundary.

degree.school_qualification_requirement: BBB at A-level including Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics.
degree.notes: Graduates apply to A100 and are assessed in the ordinary Home or International pool once eligibility is confirmed.

international_qualification.notes: Country-specific equivalences are published by Bristol but are not tabulated in the approved research. The generic engine accepts only institution-verified equivalence evidence.

post_16.notes: Academic qualifications are eligibility checks only and carry 0% weighting after the minimum requirements are met.

ucat.threshold_policy: Annual UCAT thresholds are determined dynamically after the UCAS deadline and after applicants have been ranked within the relevant pool.

sjt.notes: Bristol does not use SJT at any stage of selection in the supplied research.

conditions: Bristol considers applicants who resit qualifications.
Bristol does not require three A-levels to be taken in one sitting.

criteria: Three or more months in local authority care
Recognised University of Bristol widening participation programme completion
adjustments: Reduced A-level offer of ABB, including A in Chemistry and B in the second required science or maths subject.
Reduced IB offer of 32 points overall with 16 at Higher Level, including HL Chemistry 6 and the second required subject at HL 5.
contextual.notes: Standard contextual applicants do not receive a reduced UCAT threshold. Contextual and widening participation policies apply to Home applicants only.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Students must be at least 18 by 1 September in the year of entry for clinical experiential learning. Fitness to practise, DBS and occupational health checks apply after selection and do not affect interview guidance.

age_or_degree.notes: Graduate A100 applicants must meet the separate graduate A100 academic branch documented under post-16 degree.

non_academic.notes: Personal statements and references do not contribute to interview selection, offer selection or tie-breaking.

ranking_factors.notes: Eligible applicants are ranked by UCAT cognitive total only.

total_score.calculation_method: Use the UCAT cognitive total directly; no academic composite is calculated.
